# Sponsor Research

Sponsor and ad-read research on podcasts and YouTube, in both directions: who sponsors a show (recurring sponsors ranked by ad reads, with episode counts, first and last seen dates and sponsor status, via arcmira.sponsors) and which shows a brand sponsors (every sponsored ad read in the last 90 days, paged and grouped by show, via arcmira.recommendations with kind "sponsored"), plus the sponsors two shows share. Instruction file only, no local code: every program runs through the remote Arcmira MCP server on your account, metered in plan credits, with Pro+ sponsor filters and a recommendations gate on the brand direction.
